scope: real local Console/MinIO and two native macOS arm64 BoxLite Workers, separate single 1 GiB snapshot cycles

conditions.image_cache: existing Worker homes with the same pinned SDK image used by prior tests; no image eviction; registry, host page cache and unrelated host load uncontrolled
conditions.monitor: read-only metadata sampling and stage-log capture; sampling overhead not subtracted and monitor CPU time not measured

api_observed_seconds.timing: POST submission through observed terminal status, includes request round trip and 0.2 second polling
POST submission through observed terminal status, includes request round trip and 0.2 second polling

limits.stage_times: per awaited Worker call; include permit waits, internal verification/retries, SDK normalization/image work; multiple batches and replays are separate attempts. Sums omit Console/DB/scheduling/activation and inter-call gaps; not end-to-end latency or percentiles
limits.rates: archive MiB divided by summed awaited transfer-stage seconds. Excludes inter-call signing/scheduling gaps and is not measured wire throughput or provider/network capacity; cache_copy is local IO
limits.disk: inode-based metadata accounting of both SDK homes and journals from before child authentication/seed through cleanup/exit. Includes pre-existing image caches/history, excludes S3/build/other paths. No symlink traversal; hard-link aliases deduplicated; COW/reflink blocks can be multiply counted; brief peaks and scan races can be missed. Observed accounting, not an exact physical peak or quota recommendation
limits.comparison: separate single runs on one host; no controlled cold/hot image comparison, cross-machine proof, repeated distribution or production SLO claim
